name: pagerduty
title: PagerDuty API
description: Incidents, services, escalation policies, on-call schedules, and alerts.
notes: Requires PAGERDUTY_API_KEY (Token token=<key> format). Get it from your PagerDuty profile → API Access Keys. The Authorization header value should be 'Token token=YOUR_KEY' — set via set_api_auth if needed.
